pois.name: Little Chapel
pois.intro: The Little Chapel is situated in the Les Vauxbelets valley, Saint Andrew, Guernsey. It was created in July 1914, by Brother Déodat.

pois.name: Candie Gardens
pois.intro: Candie Gardens is a park in St Peter Port, Guernsey, originally established as a Victorian pleasure gardens in 1894.

pois.name: Hauteville House
pois.intro: Hauteville House is a house in St. Peter Port, Guernsey.

pois.name: Castle Cornet
pois.intro: Castle Cornet is a large island castle in Guernsey, and former tidal island, also known as Cornet Rock or Castle Rock. Its importance was as a defence not only of the island, but of the roadstead.

pois.name: Bordeaux Harbour
pois.intro: for other uses, see Port of Bordeaux Bordeaux Harbour is a fishing port and bay in the parish of Vale in the northeast of Guernsey, about 2 miles north of Saint Peter Port. The harbour is now used primarily as a beach, which is flat and low, "with stretches of fine sand and groups of boulders".

pois.name: Saumarez Park
pois.intro: Saumarez Park is the largest public park on the island of Guernsey.

pois.name: Sausmarez Gardens
pois.description: Historic house of the de Sausmarez family with restored Victorian walled garden.
pois.intro: Sausmarez Manor is a historic house in Saint Martin, Guernsey.

pois.name: Victoria Commemorative  Tower
pois.intro: Victoria Tower is a monument in Saint Peter Port, Guernsey, erected in honor of a visit by Queen Victoria and Prince Albert to the island in 1846.

pois.name: Bréhon Tower
pois.intro: The Bréhon Tower is accessible only by boat and sits on Bréhon Rock, an island in the Little Russell channel about 1.5 km northeast of St Peter Port, Guernsey, between the port and the islands of Herm and Jethou. Thomas Charles de Putron built the oval tower of granite from Herm, completing the work in 1857.

pois.name: German Naval Signals HQ
pois.intro: The German Naval Signals HQ is a bunker in St. Peter Port that was used by the Germans during the German occupation of the Channel Islands.

pois.name: Castle Breakwater Light
pois.intro: Le phare du Château est un phare maritime situé en bout de la jetée du port de Saint-Pierre-Port, proche du Château Cornet, à Guernesey. Il est géré par les autorités portuaires de Guernesey.

pois.name: Vale Castle
pois.intro: Vale Castle, is a protected building located in the Vale, Guernsey. The original name was "Le Château St Michel", later it became "Château de Val" or "Château de Valle" and is over 1,000 years old.

pois.name: Pepper Pot
pois.description: Guard house large enough for only one soldier.

pois.name: Fort Hommett
pois.description: Built on the site of fortifications dating from 1680, and consists of a Martello tower from 1804, later additions during the Victorian Era, and bunkers & casemates that the Germans constructed during WW II. Source: Wikipedia
pois.intro: Fort Hommet is a fortification on Vazon Bay headland in Castel, Guernsey.

pois.description: Single chamber Neolithic passgate grave. Associated aith witchcraft in C17th. Source: BBC
